story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Homepage content query (`layouts/home.html`) excludes pages with `growth_stage: "withered"` by default. 2. Section list pages (e.g. `/articles/`, `/logs/`) and taxonomy term pages (categories, tags) exclude withered content by default. Implemented in `layouts/list.html`. 3. Archive page (`layouts/page/archive.html`) and the archive sidebar widget (`layouts/_partials/widgets/archive.html`) exclude withered content from the listings and from the year-grouped counts. 4. Withered content remains accessible via direct URL — `layouts/single.html` renders withered pages normally; deep links and bookmarks continue to work. 5. Withered content remains included in the search index `layouts/index.json` (no filter applied there). 6. A count of hidden withered items is rendered on the homepage and on filtered list pages, e.g. `💀 3 verwelkte Inhalte ausgeblendet`. The badge is screen-reader accessible (`aria-live="polite"`) and only renders when the hidden count is > 0. 7. Footer statistics block (`layouts/_partials/_base/footer.html` lines 42–63) displays counts split between **published** (non-withered) and **withered**; total entry count remains accurate. Pattern: `Momentan befinden sich N Einträge — davon X verwelkt`. 8. The `404.html` "recent articles" widget (line 18) excludes withered content (no organic discovery via 404 page). 9. Single-page prev/next/related-articles candidates (`layouts/single.html` lines 154, 162, 183–184) exclude withered content so withered pages are not surfaced via organic adjacent-page navigation. (Direct URL still works per AC #4.) 10. RSS feed (`layouts/rss.xml`) is OUT OF SCOPE for this story — withered handling for RSS is owned by Story 1.5. 11. No regressions to the existing `weight` ordering in `home.html` (lines 13–25): the three weight-buckets continue to work; withered is filtered out before bucketing. 12. Build succeeds cleanly with the existing fixture mix (Story 1.1 test fixtures + at least one new withered fixture).

tests.standards:
Authoritative test plan: `docs/2-solutioning/test-design-system.md` (Test Architect Murat, 2025-11-15). Stack: Playwright (E2E + visual regression + axe-core a11y) + Node test runner (`node --test`) for build/script smoke. Story 1.1 bootstrapped this infrastructure (Playwright config, smoke spec, npm scripts, CI workflow); Story 1.3 ADDS build-smoke assertions (homepage HTML excludes withered permalink; withered direct URL HTTP 200) and a new Playwright spec (`tests/e2e/withered-hiding.spec.ts`).
Story 1.3 introduces the first axe-core a11y assertion — the homepage with the `.withered-hidden-notice` rendered must produce zero new violations. This validates `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"` + non-decorative label text + WCAG-AA contrast against the page background.
Manual verification still required for visual fidelity (notice typography, vertical rhythm) and end-to-end sanity (homepage cards exclude withered, section pages exclude withered, taxonomy term pages exclude withered, archive page year groupings exclude withered, sidebar widget per-year counts match, footer stats counters reflect non-withered totals plus the `— davon X verwelkt` suffix when withered count > 0, withered direct URL still 200s, single-page series/related lists exclude withered, search index `curl /index.json` still contains the withered fixture entry).
Production build smoke: `hugo --environment production` must render the notice correctly after PurgeCSS — verify the `.withered-hidden-notice` selector survives purge. Safelist only on regression.
tests.locations: - tests/build/fixtures/withered-article.md (NEW — adds to Story 1.1's fixtures dir) - tests/build/build-smoke.test.mjs (MODIFY — extend with two new assertions) - tests/e2e/withered-hiding.spec.ts (NEW — Playwright + axe-core) - tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts (REFERENCE — Story 1.1; not modified) - playwright.config.ts (REFERENCE — Story 1.1; not modified) - docs/technical/testing.md (MODIFY — append Story 1.3 subsection) - content/articles/, content/logs/ (DO NOT commit ad-hoc test articles here — use tests/build/fixtures/)
tests.ideas: - AC #1, #11: Homepage build assertion — render `public/index.html`, assert it does NOT contain the withered fixture's permalink AND assert all three weight-bucket ranges still render their non-withered members in the expected order. - AC #2: Section page `/articles/` and `/logs/` build assertions — rendered HTML excludes the withered fixture's permalink. Term pages (e.g. `/categories//`) where the withered fixture lives in that category — rendered HTML excludes its permalink. Term INDEX page (`/categories/`) — term cards still render (taxonomy branch unchanged); per-term card count reflects non-withered total. - AC #3: Archive page `/pages/archiv/` build assertion — withered fixture not in any year group; year-totals reflect non-withered counts. Sidebar archive widget per-year counts match. - AC #4: Withered direct URL — Playwright test navigates to the fixture's permalink, asserts HTTP 200 and article body renders. Build assertion: `public//index.html` exists and is non-empty. - AC #5: `curl /index.json` (or build assertion on `public/index.json`) — confirm withered fixture entry IS present (search index intentionally retains). - AC #6: Playwright homepage test — `.withered-hidden-notice` element visible with text matching `/\d+ verwelkte/`. Singular variant: stage exactly one withered fixture, expect text containing `1 verwelkte … Inhalt ist`. Plural variant: stage 2+ withered fixtures, expect `Inhalte sind`. Element only renders when count > 0 — when zero, assert element absent. - AC #6 (a11y): axe-core assertion on homepage with notice rendered → zero new violations. Specifically validate `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"` attributes, non-decorative label text (icon `aria-hidden="true"`), and WCAG-AA contrast. - AC #7: Footer counters build assertion — total reflects non-withered count; pattern includes `— davon X verwelkt` when X > 0; pattern omits the suffix when X == 0; `$countA` and `$countM` reflect non-withered articles/logs respectively. - AC #8: 404 page Playwright test — navigate to non-existent URL (or `/404.html` directly), assert recent-articles list excludes the withered fixture. - AC #9: Single-page Playwright test — open a non-withered article in the same series as a withered fixture; assert the series widget does NOT include the withered title. Open a non-withered article and assert the related-articles widget does NOT include the withered title. - AC #10 negative test: Verify `layouts/rss.xml` is byte-identical to baseline (Story 1.3 must NOT touch it). - AC #11: Build-smoke regression — render the homepage with three articles weighted (1, 2, nil) plus the withered fixture; assert the three buckets render in `weight DESC` then `date DESC` then `nil` order, and the withered fixture is absent from all three. - AC #12: Build smoke runs `hugo --quiet --environment production` against the fixture mix (Story 1.1 fixtures + new withered fixture) and exits 0. - Default-fallback regression (Story 1.1 contract): build with the existing `valid-missing-field.md` fixture (no `growth_stage`); assert it remains visible on the homepage (Hugo `ne` semantics retain absent fields). - PurgeCSS regression: post-`hugo --environment production`, assert `.withered-hidden-notice` styles are applied (computed style on the rendered notice has the expected color and italic font-style). - Pure-function partial guard: assert that calling `partial "withered-filter.html" $pages` and `partial "withered-count.html" $pages` produces NO HTML output by themselves — wrap the call in a probe template and assert empty string body.
